items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And then Benny Carter was in the band, and he was just getting started

ctx.x: It was like a private club. Then he moved me over to Small's Paradise. And I worked with Charlie Johnson there for about a year.
Then that's where I met Benny Waters. And then Benny Carter was in the band, and he was just getting started -- him and Benny Waters. He had a great band.
